name: Icon button
statusNote: Five sizes (XS-XL), the narrow/uniform/wide width options, and a round/square shape choice are new in Expressive; the standard/filled/filled-tonal/outlined colour variants are unchanged in concept.
summary: A button whose entire content is a single icon, for compact actions in toolbars, app bars, list rows and cards. Choose the colour style for emphasis and the width option to fit the surrounding layout.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: The button's single icon content, typically 24x24dp.

inputs.name: contentDescription
inputs.description: Mandatory accessibility label; icon-only content has no visible text to fall back on.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Selects the token group that drives container height and icon size.

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: Colour style; selects the matching comp.*-icon-button token group.

inputs.name: widthOption
inputs.description: Container width, independent of size and style. Width is derived as icon-size + (leading-space + trailing-space) for the chosen option; height is always the size's fixed container-height regardless of width option.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: Resting silhouette, from the size's container-shape-round or container-shape-square token. Square is also offered as a per-instance resting choice, independent of checked state.

inputs.name: vibrant
inputs.description: Selects the high-contrast icon colour (the style's color token) instead of the muted default that inherits the ambient content colour. Only changes anything for the standard and outlined styles; filled and filled-tonal always use their own container/icon colour tokens and have no vibrant variant.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Disables the button and applies the style's disabled opacities.

inputs.name: checkable
inputs.description: Makes the button a two-state toggle (IconToggleButton/FilledIconToggleButton/FilledTonalIconToggleButton/OutlinedIconToggleButton), changing its role to checkbox and adding the checked state.

inputs.name: checked
inputs.description: Current toggle state. Only meaningful when checkable is true; the caller owns it.

inputs.name: onCheckedChange
inputs.description: Called with the new checked value when a checkable button is clicked.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Standard has none (transparent); filled and filled-tonal are solid; outlined has a 1px stroke.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: Single icon, centered in the container.

variants.description: Recommended for small screens. Width = icon-size + narrow-leading-space + narrow-trailing-space.

Recommended for medium-width screens. Width = icon-size + default-leading-space + default-trailing-space (large size names these uniform-leading-space/uniform-trailing-space instead of default-*; see notes).
Fully rounded resting shape, from container-shape-round.

layout.text: Width is derived, not read from a single token: width = leading-space + trailing-space + icon-size for the chosen width option, using that option's per-size leading/trailing tokens (narrow-*, default-*/uniform-*, wide-*).
Height is the size's fixed container-height token regardless of the chosen width option.
Icon size is fixed per size bucket and does not change with the width option.
Width and size are orthogonal axes: a toolbar can mix a narrow x-small icon button with a wide large one; do not couple them in the component model.

states.text: Rest shape morphs to the size's pressed-container-shape token, the same mechanism as Button.

A checkable icon button's shape becomes the size's selected-container-shape-round or selected-container-shape-square token; role becomes checkbox. The same default-effects spring drives this transition as the plain press morph.
Applies the style's disabled colour and opacity tokens; the outlined style's disabled border additionally uses its disabled-outline-color at the same disabled opacity, with no extra hardcoded value.

behaviour.text: A checkable icon button calls onCheckedChange(!checked) on click; the caller owns the checked value.

Role is checkbox for every checkable icon button variant and button for every non-checkable one; never radio, even inside a mutually exclusive group — grouping/exclusivity is the container's job (e.g. button-group or segmented control), not this component's.

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the button.
For a checkable button, Space or Enter also toggles checked and the checkbox role's checked state is announced.
semantics: Icon-only content has no visible label; a content description is mandatory on every instance.
A checkable button uses the checkbox role, not button, and announces checked/unchecked.

notes.text: The plain (non-vibrant, non-toggle) IconButton default colours do not read the style's colour token at all for standard/outlined icon buttons: iconButtonColors() just inherits the ambient LocalContentColor with a transparent container. Only the explicit iconButtonVibrantColors()/outlinedIconButtonVibrantColors() default (the vibrant input here) reads comp.standard-icon-button.color / comp.outlined-icon-button.color. Filled and filled-tonal always read their own container-color/color tokens regardless, and have no vibrant variant.

Every size's uniform/default width calculation adds the leading-space token to itself (DefaultLeadingSpace + DefaultLeadingSpace, or UniformLeadingSpace + UniformLeadingSpace for large) instead of adding leading-space + trailing-space; the narrow and wide calculations correctly add their distinct leading and trailing tokens. This makes the corresponding default-trailing-space / uniform-trailing-space token unreachable from this code path. It is numerically harmless only because each size's default/uniform leading and trailing values happen to be equal.

The uniform-width tokens are named inconsistently across sizes: x-small, small, medium and x-large call them default-leading-space/default-trailing-space, but large calls the same concept uniform-leading-space/uniform-trailing-space.

container-shape-square is not only a toggle-checked shape; it is also offered as an alternate resting shape per size, same as Button. Treat round vs. square as a per-instance style choice independent of checked state.
